ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly/regression: p95 small-batch up 18% vs baseline on runtime-nightly (job 4523). artifacts: https://ci/redwood/artifacts/4523 :rotating_light:

sasha: saw this, grabbing logs. arjun are you able to triage? i'm on call til 03:00 PT.

arjun: yep i'll start a quick bisect. pinging maya for a flame/profile capture if we need deeper stacks.

maya: got it — kicking off `perf` capture on the failing commit (abc123). command: ```sh
python infra/bench/run_bench.py --suite small_batch --commit abc123 --samples 30 --profile perf.data
``` will share link when done.

ci-bot: artifact snapshot: https://ci/redwood/artifacts/4523/snapshot.tar.gz (bench logs + traces)

arjun: quick check: baseline (commit def456) -> p95=88ms, suspect commit abc123 -> p95=105ms. re-running with `--alloc-trace` now.

sasha: if bisect points at the mempool change PR, we should try a quick revert on a staging pool before prod rollback. noah, can infra move a handful of hosts to pre-rollback image for verification?

noah: yes I can stageroll 6 hosts into the rollback image. scheduling at 01:40 PT, will update when ready.

maya: upload link for perf capture: https://ci/redwood/artifacts/4523/perf_abc123.tar.gz — flamegraphs inside. early look shows increased time in `kv_cache::serialize`.

arjun: interesting — testing a run with `--cache-bypass` to confirm. command: `python infra/bench/run_bench.py --suite small_batch --commit abc123 --samples 20 --flags='--cache-bypass'`

ops-bot: autoscaling adjusted: reduced max concurrency for nightly-run fleet by 20% to limit blast radius :gear:

arjun: okay bisect narrowed to PR #784 — mempool allocator tweaks. local repro with `--cache-bypass` returns to baseline, so interplay with KV cache likely.

sasha: plan: arjun files a regression PR with bisect log + perf artifacts, maya attaches flamegraphs, noah prepares staged hosts for quick verification, i'll be ready to approve revert if infra confirms.

arjun: filing PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 — includes bisect steps, raw traces, perf summaries.

noah: stageroll done, verification run queued: https://ci/redwood/jobs/4589 — will report pass/fail in ~12m.

maya: quick note: if we do a revert, remember to bump quant profile tests — they flake with mempool changes.

sasha: ack. tagging @eng-sre for awareness. :eyes:

noah: verification finished: p95 back to 89ms on staged hosts. looks like revert will fix.

sasha: thanks all. arjun please post PR with revert candidate and exact rollback window. we'll target a patch release at 04:00 PT if nothing else pops up.

arjun: will do. handing off to morning shift for follow-up. :thumbsup:
